verdict.rationale: The only on-topic first-party evidence is the Teams Export APIs. They let you export 1:1, group, meeting and channel messages, including user-deleted messages for up to 21 days, which gives programmatic access to full history but is not a filtered search. Community reports say search is 'abysmal', that you can't search within a channel, and that results can only be sorted by date modified. That undercuts the channel filter, but it is not a contradiction of a vendor claim, since the vendor never claims filtered search. missing for 10: documented admin search over full message history, sender/channel/date filters, any first-party search or eDiscovery docs, positive hands-on corroboration.
